semiconductor_relevance: High — HK Tech Co., Ltd. provides specialized ceramic materials crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: HK Tech Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced ceramic materials and components, primarily for the semiconductor and flat panel display industries. The company leverages over 20 years of expertise in ceramic processing technology to deliver high-quality products using materials like Aluminum Nitride (AlN), Silicon Carbide (SiC), and Titanium Dioxide (TiO2).
capabilities: Manufacturing of ceramic components using AlN, SiC, and TiO2
Advanced quality control with 3D measuring machines and digital microscopes
Development of innovative ceramic processing technologies
